name: claude-multi-agent-dev
description: Claude Code multi-agent workspace for Autonomous Vehicle development based on Autoware — Lead plus 10 specialist agents (hardware, sensing, localization, mapping, perception, planning, control, system-evaluator, tuning, researcher) with a live orchestration dashboard.

scripts.dashboard:stop: bash -c 'if [ -f dashboard/.dashboard.pid ]; then kill $(cat dashboard/.dashboard.pid) 2>/dev/null; rm dashboard/.dashboard.pid; echo stopped; else echo not running; fi'
